_comment: ShellTerra OceanBeachActivities seed data. Shell: OceanBeachActivities. Times are San Diego local, 24h. Source: Eventbrite Ocean Beach bounding-box search (top 32.762 / bottom 32.730 / left -117.262 / right -117.230), pulled 2026-09-09, plus Ocean Beach MainStreet Association, OB Planning Board, and OB Town Council. Dropped: all Marina Village Conference Center and Quivira Way/Road listings (1936 Quivira, 1548 Quivira, 2600 Bayside, Mission Point) since those are Mission Bay in 92109, not Ocean Beach. Dropped: online-only events. ALL COORDINATES ARE APPROXIMATE. Venue pins came from Eventbrite venue records and were not independently verified.
_verify_before_running: SHELL_ID in .env must be the Ocean Beach shell id before seeding. The _shellId field above is a placeholder and will fail if seeded as is.
Every lat/lng: drop each pin in Google Maps and confirm it lands on the right venue. Sunset Cliffs listings in particular resolve to street-level pins, not to a specific meeting spot.

Sunset Cliffs yoga cluster: seven separate organizers run classes at or near Sunset Cliffs Blvd & Adair St. Confirm they are genuinely distinct offerings and not duplicate listings of the same class before seeding all of them.

Saratoga Park yoga cluster: Kaiti Yoga (Sat 10am), Kyle Lyman (Sat 9am), and Lily Borisov (Mon 6pm) all list Saratoga Park. Kyle Lyman also teaches the Pacific Beach Wednesday class in the PB shell, so the same instructor spans two shells.

OB Town Council: 4th Wednesday 7pm is from a City of San Diego listing that still shows Underground Elephant at 1711 Sunset Cliffs Blvd as the venue. VENUE AND SCHEDULE ARE STALE. Confirm at obtowncouncil.org before pinning.
Winstons weekly nights (reggae, trivia, karaoke): the nights are confirmed on winstonsob.com but START TIMES ARE ESTIMATES. Confirm with the venue before seeding.
OB Oktoberfest: dates Oct 9-10 2026 confirmed via OBMA. Hours are estimates. Confirm at oboktoberfest.com.

OB Farmers Market hours: 4-8pm confirmed by both OBMA and the City of San Diego listing. Market runs the 4900 block of Newport between Cable and Bacon, so the pin is a block centroid, not a single address.

Chakra Breathwork at Origin Modern Health & Wellness: Eventbrite returned an end time of 07:30 the following morning, which is almost certainly a data entry error. End time here is set to 20:00. Confirm before seeding.
Oceanfront Sunset Yoga (Yoga In Beautiful Places): Eventbrite lists a 3 hour block for what reads as a 1 hour class. Confirm actual duration.
200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training (Feb 2027) is a multi-week course, not a single session. Decide whether a training program belongs in the activities collection at all.
OB Planning Board and OB Town Council are civic recurring meetings and may already exist in the CPG calendar work. Check for duplicates before seeding.
Several one-off Eventbrite listings are commercial ticketed shows (The Harp, The Holding Company, Winstons). Confirm they clear whatever commercial-content rule the shell uses.
Recurrence flags below were inferred from Eventbrite child-event counts. Confirm each weekly series actually repeats indefinitely rather than running a fixed number of sessions.

items.title: OB Farmers Market
items.description: Ocean Beach's certified farmers market, running the full 4900 block of Newport Avenue between Cable and Bacon every Wednesday afternoon. Produce, seafood, meat, dairy, prepared food, flowers and craft vendors, plus live music and street performers. Newport closes to traffic for it. The single most reliable weekly event in the neighborhood.

items.title: Wednesday Night Art Market at Kilowatt
items.description: Weekly art market inside Kilowatt Brewing on Cable Street, running the same evening as the Newport Ave farmers market a block over. Local makers and artists selling directly, with the taproom open throughout. Free to walk through.

items.title: Reggae Night at Winstons
items.description: Winstons Beach Club runs reggae every Wednesday. Winstons is OB's main live music room and has been for decades. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE, confirm with the venue.

items.title: Trivia Night at Winstons
items.description: Thursday trivia at Winstons Beach Club. Team format in a live music venue rather than a dedicated trivia bar, so it runs louder than most. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE, confirm with the venue.

items.title: OB-o-Ke Karaoke at Winstons
items.description: Sunday karaoke at Winstons hosted by K-Rud. Long-running OB institution and closer to a performance night than a sign-up-and-mumble karaoke bar. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE, confirm with the venue.

items.title: Sunday Morning Yoga on Sunset Cliffs, 9 AM
items.description: Yoga Jawn's Sunday 9am class on the bluff at 1253 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Outdoor, ocean-facing, bring your own mat. The same organizer runs an 11am session, so pick the slot rather than assuming one class.
items.address: 1253 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Sunday Morning Yoga on Sunset Cliffs, 11 AM
items.description: Yoga Jawn's later Sunday session at the Sunset Cliffs parking area. Same instructor and format as the 9am class, two hours later and usually busier once the morning marine layer burns off.
items.address: 1253 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Sunday Morning Sunset Cliffs Yoga
items.description: Sunday 10am class at the Adair Street entrance to Sunset Cliffs Natural Park. Separate organizer from the Yoga Jawn sessions at 1253 Sunset Cliffs, though the two run within a few blocks of each other on the same morning.
items.address: Adair St & Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Saturday Donation Yoga at Sunset Cliffs
items.description: All-levels donation-based Saturday morning class from Mind Body Badass at the Sunset Cliffs Blvd and Adair St entrance to the natural park. Pay what you can, bring a mat, expect wind off the water.
items.locationName: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park at Adair St
items.address: Sunset Cliffs Blvd & Adair St, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Wednesday Stretch Flow Donation Yoga at Sunset Cliffs
items.description: Mind Body Badass's midweek evening companion to their Saturday class. Slower stretch flow format at the Adair St cliffs entrance, donation based, timed to run into sunset.
items.locationName: Sunset Cliffs Natural Park at Adair St
items.address: Sunset Cliffs Blvd & Adair St, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Thursday Sunset Yoga Flow on Sunset Cliffs
items.description: Thursday evening flow with Danielle MacGregor at the Sunset Cliffs Blvd and Adair St corner. One of the longest-running series in the cliffs cluster by occurrence count. Outdoor and weather dependent.
items.address: Sunset Cliffs Blvd & Adair St, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Oceanfront Sunset Yoga at Sunset Cliffs
items.description: Evening class from Yoga In Beautiful Places at 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Same organizer runs the new moon and full moon sessions at this spot. DURATION UNCONFIRMED, the listing shows a three hour block for what reads as a one hour class.
items.address: 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Monday Flowstate Yoga at the Cliffs
items.description: Monday evening outdoor flow from Soulfish Yoga at the Adair Street cliffs access. Starts the week on the bluff rather than in a studio. Bring a mat and something warm for after.

items.title: Ocean Beach Yoga at Saratoga Park
items.description: Saturday 9am class with Kyle Lyman at Saratoga Park, a block off the sand at the north end of OB. Same instructor who runs the Wednesday Pacific Beach class, so this is a cross-neighborhood regular.

items.title: Beachfront Yoga Saturday Mornings in OB
items.description: Kaiti Yoga's Saturday 10am session at Saratoga Park. Runs an hour after the Kyle Lyman class in the same park, so confirm which one a user actually means before pinning both.

items.title: Beach Yoga at Saratoga Park
items.description: Monday evening class with Lily Borisov at Saratoga Park in Ocean Beach. Small group outdoor format at the top of the beach access. Bring your own mat.

items.title: Yin and Sound Bowl Healing
items.description: Kaiti Yoga's yin plus sound bowl session at 2183 Bacon St. Long-running weekly series by occurrence count. Slow-hold yin postures with sound bath layered over the top. Indoor, mats usually available.

items.title: Moon Body
items.description: Weekly evening movement and breath session from Josie Duraso at 2183 Bacon St, the same room that hosts the Kaiti Yoga yin series. Recurring series with a long run of scheduled sessions.

items.title: Drifting Roots at The Harp
items.description: Live reggae from Drifting Roots at The Harp on Newport Ave. The Harp books local and touring acts most weekends and sits in the middle of the Newport bar strip.

items.title: Sunset Cliffs Auto Show
items.description: Annual family-friendly car show presented by Hodad's, held the weekend after Labor Day at the Inn at Sunset Cliffs. Classic and custom vehicles, food, live music and raffles. Free to walk through. One of the neighborhood's established annual events.
items.address: 1370 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Kinder Rave
items.description: Daytime all-ages dance party at The Template on Niagara Ave. Family format, so the volume and the hours are set for kids rather than a club crowd. Afternoon only.

items.title: Community Meetup at Wonderland Ocean Pub
items.description: Midday meetup hosted by Sincerely, Divorced at Wonderland Ocean Pub on Santa Monica Ave. Support-oriented social rather than a general mixer. Wonderland sits directly across from the beach at the end of Newport.
items.address: 5083 Santa Monica Ave Suite 2B, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Night Circuit at Connect San Diego
items.description: Late night house and electronic set at Connect Gallery on Newport Ave, running from 8pm past midnight. Gallery space rather than a club, so the room is smaller and the sound is closer than a standard EDM night.

items.title: Book and Puzzle Swap at Sine Wave Cafe
items.description: See You in SD's book and puzzle swap at Sine Wave Cafe on Santa Monica Ave. Bring what you have finished, take what you have not read. Cafe format, no ticket needed beyond signing up.
items.address: 4810 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Coffee Meet Up at Ultreya
items.description: Midday coffee social from Black Wolf Social Club at Ultreya Coffee and Tea on Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Informal, no agenda, aimed at people who want a low-commitment way to meet others in the neighborhood.
items.address: 1785 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: New Moon Manifest and Align at Sunset Cliffs
items.description: New moon session from Yoga In Beautiful Places at 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Intention-setting format tied to the lunar cycle rather than a standard class. Pairs with the full moon session the same organizer runs later in the month.
items.address: 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: The Ocean Beach Sound Bath
items.description: Evening sound bath run by Guy Douglas out of the OB Jiu-Jitsu Collective mat room on Newport Ave. Billed as a nervous system reset. Mats on the floor, lights down, roughly 75 minutes.
items.address: 4944 Newport Ave Unit D, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Algorhythm Live and Unplugged at The Harp
items.description: Acoustic set from Algorhythm at The Harp Ocean Beach. Unplugged format, so quieter than the venue's usual weekend booking. Late start.

items.title: Kush Yoga Under the Sky Hybrid Flow
items.description: Evening hybrid flow from Kush Yoga at Humble Heart on Newport Ave. Hybrid means part indoor studio, part rooftop or outdoor depending on weather. Check the listing for what to bring.

items.title: Patchwork Fall Craft Party at Mike Hess
items.description: Patchwork's fall craft night at Mike Hess Brewing Ocean Beach: sun catchers and chunky pumpkins. Materials included in the ticket, beer is your own tab. Patchwork runs these on a rotating schedule at the Voltaire St taproom.

items.title: Tree of Life Cacao Ceremony with Hypnotic Harp
items.description: Third Friday cacao ceremony at Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center on Voltaire St, with live harp. Ceremonial format rather than a class. Registration required, group size is capped.
items.locationName: Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center

items.title: Ocean Beach DJ Set on Abbott St
items.description: Free evening DJ set from Alex Zinn at 1950 Abbott St, a block from the sand. Four hour run into the evening, no ticket. Confirm whether this is an indoor venue or a street-adjacent setup before pinning.

items.title: Sacred Protection Mini Mystic Market
items.description: Afternoon mystic market at 4862 Voltaire St. Small vendor format with readers, crystals, and handmade goods. Four hour window, walk-in.

items.title: Bonfire Social Mixer at Ocean Beach
items.description: Late evening bonfire mixer from Conexio on the OB sand. Fire ring format, runs past midnight. EXACT MEETING SPOT IS UNCONFIRMED, the listing gives only Ocean Beach. Confirm which fire ring before pinning.

items.title: Floating Aerial Sound Bath
items.description: Sound bath taken lying in aerial hammocks at Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center. Different experience from a mat-based sound bath since you are suspended for the full session. Recurring series, spaces capped by hammock count.
items.locationName: Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center

items.title: The Wellness Social at Align
items.description: Afternoon networking social for wellness practitioners and anyone in that orbit, at Align Wellness and Aesthetics on Voltaire St. Structured as a meet-and-mingle rather than a class or treatment.

items.title: TAPSD 2026 at The Holding Company
items.description: Hip hop bill at The Holding Company on Newport Ave featuring Trae Tha Truth, Conway, Grafh and T.F. Ticketed show, doors early evening. The Holding Company is the larger of the two Newport Ave music rooms.

items.title: Ocean Beach Town Council Public Meeting
items.description: Monthly public meeting of the Ocean Beach Town Council, open to the neighborhood. Covers local issues and community programming. VENUE AND SCHEDULE ARE UNCONFIRMED, the City listing still shows a fourth Wednesday 7pm meeting at 1711 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Verify at obtowncouncil.org before pinning.
items.address: 1711 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Poetry Saves Lives at Valkyrie Yoga
items.description: Spoken word and poetry evening at Valkyrie Yoga on Santa Monica Ave. Studio space converted for a reading rather than a class. Small room, roughly 90 minutes.
items.address: 4876 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Matcha and Moss Mini Plant Garden Workshop
items.description: Late morning terrarium workshop from The Plant Corner by Jasmine at Coffee Cycle Roasting on Voltaire St. Build a small planted garden to take home. Materials included, coffee is separate.

items.title: Full Moon Release and Renew at Sunset Cliffs
items.description: Full moon counterpart to the new moon session from Yoga In Beautiful Places at 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Release-focused rather than intention-setting. Outdoor on the bluff, dress for wind.
items.address: 1352 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Acu Sound Healing at Pier to Point
items.description: Acupuncture combined with sound healing in one session at Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center. Needles plus bowls, evening slot, roughly 90 minutes. Pre-registration required.
items.locationName: Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center

items.title: Chakra Breathwork at Origin Modern Health and Wellness
items.description: Chakra-specific breathwork class series at 2204 Sunset Cliffs Blvd. Recurring format across several sessions. END TIME IS AN ESTIMATE, the source listing returned an end time the following morning which is almost certainly a data error.
items.address: 2204 Sunset Cliffs Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Ocean Beach Planning Board General Meeting
items.description: Monthly general meeting of the Ocean Beach Planning Board, the community planning group for OB. First Tuesday of each month at the Ocean Beach Recreation Center on Santa Monica Ave. Open to the public, Brown Act noticed. Development projects, permits and community plan items.
items.address: 4726 Santa Monica Ave, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: OB Oktoberfest, Friday
items.description: Night one of Ocean Beach's Oktoberfest, held where Newport Ave meets the pier. Two stages of live music, a 21+ beachfront beer garden with German and local pours, food vendors, contests and giveaways. Run by OBMA, which puts the proceeds back into the neighborhood. HOURS ARE ESTIMATES, confirm at oboktoberfest.com.

items.title: OB Oktoberfest, Saturday
items.description: Night two of OB Oktoberfest at the foot of Newport Ave. Same beer garden and two-stage setup as Friday, with the fuller day of programming. VIP tickets include a one liter mug and main stage access. HOURS ARE ESTIMATES, confirm at oboktoberfest.com.

items.title: Selecta Fari presents Rootikal Riddim
items.description: Late night roots and dub selection from Selecta Fari at The Harp. Runs the same night as Oktoberfest a few blocks down Newport, so expect the strip to be busy either way.

items.title: Patchwork Succulent Pumpkins Craft Workshop
items.description: Patchwork's succulent pumpkin build at Mike Hess Brewing Ocean Beach. Plant a real succulent arrangement into a pumpkin. Materials included, taproom open throughout. Same series as their fall craft party in September.

items.title: HalloWomen Spooktacular at Winstons
items.description: Halloween-season live music showcase at Winstons Beach Club hosted by Sara Jade. Costume-friendly, late start, runs to close.

items.title: Pride Out Pickleball Social and Open Play
items.description: Evening pickleball social and open play at Barnes Tennis Center on West Point Loma Blvd. Social format, all levels. Barnes sits at the eastern edge of the OB area near Robb Field.
items.address: 4490 W Point Loma Blvd, San Diego, CA 92107

items.title: Dia de los Muertos at Winstons
items.description: Afternoon Dia de los Muertos event at Winstons Beach Club from Electric Playground. Daytime slot rather than the venue's usual late booking, so it reads more community than club.

items.title: Brewdoodle Drink and Draw at Kilowatt
items.description: Drink and draw night at Kilowatt Brewing Ocean Beach. Bring your own supplies or use what is on the table, no skill level assumed. Runs the evening after their Wednesday art market.

items.title: Shop Small, Shop Local Ocean Beach
items.description: OBMA's holiday shopping campaign across Newport Ave and the surrounding business district, running from the Friday after Thanksgiving through mid December. Bingo card format with prizes for shopping at participating OB businesses. Campaign rather than a single event, so treat the start date as the kickoff.

items.title: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training at Pier to Point
items.description: 200 hour yoga teacher training program run by Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center on Voltaire St. Multi-week certification course, not a drop-in class. The start date below is the first session only. Decide whether a training program belongs in the activities collection before seeding.
items.locationName: Pier to Point Yoga and Wellness Center

items.title: OB Kite Festival
items.description: The oldest children's kite festival in the United States, held at Robb Field. Kite building and decorating, flying demonstrations, carnival rides and crafts. Free family event run in partnership with OBMA. Confirm the 2027 date closer to the time.

items.title: OB Street Fair and Chili Cook-Off
items.description: The neighborhood's largest annual event. Newport Ave closes for a full day of food, art, entertainment, shopping and a beer garden, anchored by the chili cook-off. Free to attend, 10am to 8pm. Confirm the 2027 date with OBMA closer to the time.
